page.overview:
Who is Zara?

Zara is a non-canon character that makes an appearance in the animated series Mortal Kombat: Defenders of the Realm and was voiced by Nancy Linari. She was a female Amazonian warrior who served as the ruler of her own realm.

At some point, her home dimension was conquered by the armies of Shao Kahn and incorporated into Outworld. She would form an alliance with Princess Kitana and Ramath, the Keeper of the Crystal Realm, in order to bring about an armed rebellion against Shao Kahn's forces. However, she would betray her comrades in order to gain the Swords of Ilkan during the fighting which resulted in the death of Ramath and Zara's banishment.

She would spend many years and lose many of her warriors in finding one of the Swords of Ilkan. She would later fight against Princess Kitana once again and her Earthrealm comrades. After capturing Jax in a life draining sphere made by her Sword of Ilkan, she demanded that Kitana find the remaining sword so that she could be the undisputed ruler of the realms.

After Kitana recovered the second sword, Zara and her would engage in personal combat, but when she started to lose, Zara attempted to make use of one of the Swords of Ilkan but was defeated. Kitana opened a rift into the Void and banished Zara into that realm.
